ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.name: Maine Supreme Judicial Court — Law Court (simulated alternate-history bench)
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.jurisdiction: Maine statewide; court of last resort; appeals from Superior, District, Probate and certain administrative actions; case-specific review required
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.role: Associate Justice of the Maine Supreme Judicial Court, appellate Law Court capacity
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.appeal_route: State court of last resort; further federal judicial review only where legally available and independently verified
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.appointment: Maine Governor appointment; Senate confirmation; seven-year term; assumed fictional oath/start must be supported before active campaign
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.staffing: Seven judicial seats (one Chief Justice, six Associate Justices); law clerks serve full Court but have chamber assignments; clerk of the Law Court manages appellate docket
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.rules: Maine Rules of Appellate Procedure (2024 compilation), Maine Code of Judicial Conduct (2024), Court rules and relevant administrative orders; details and amendments must be checked before use
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.judicial_power: Questions of law on appeals; published decisions bind Maine lower courts; administrative rulemaking and narrow constitutional advisory role
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.location: Portland chambers selected for player, Maine; arguments normally Cumberland County Courthouse unless announced otherwise
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.opinion_workflow: Submitted record -> issue identification -> written submissions -> argument if ordered -> justice-only deliberation -> drafting and circulation -> separate votes and joins by opinion part -> review and issuance; specific assignment practices must be verified
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.ethical_boundaries: Impartiality, conflicts/recusal, ex parte restrictions, court confidentiality: apply Maine judicial conduct rules after rule-specific review
readiness_gaps: Review rule-specific filing, service, deadline, oral argument and reconsideration provisions against official Maine Rules of Appellate Procedure text

Prepare first fictional appellate case including actual initial filed briefs, trial order, docket record and appendix, with stable logical pages and verified law
Check simulated appointment timeline and oath basis; separate fictional branch from real judicial roster
Validate complete case package and operational profile before setting status ready; no automatic first-case assignment
